Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Operațiuni și întreținere pentru sisteme IT și Dezvoltare de software personalizat pentru sisteme IT
We are looking for two Cloud Engineers with strong Azure networking skills to join our team for a leading client in the energy and critical infrastructure sector. The ideal candidates are hands-on engineers who can deliver cloud infrastructure and connectivity work to a high standard, automate it with Infrastructure as Code and work independently with minimal guidance.
 The successful candidates will join a small, experienced team working on the client’s cloud modernisation programme. The work focuses on cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-datacentre connectivity using SD-WAN, a Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) rollout and some backup work with Rubrik . We are hiring two engineers: one with hands-on SD-WAN / SASE experience (ideally Cato Networks) and one with experience in enterprise backup (ideally Rubrik) . The role is remote from Romania, working UK hours with an English-speaking UK team.
 Responsibilities: 
Build and configure cloud infrastructure and networking in Microsoft Azure (and AWS where needed), including cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-datacentre connectivity.
Deliver SD-WAN integration work for a proof of concept and the phases that follow it.
Support the rollout of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA).
Build automation and deployment patterns using Infrastructure as Code ( Terraform ) and CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab).
For one of the two roles: configure and validate Rubrik backups.
Make sure solutions follow security best practices and the client’s standards for managing changes.
Work with architects, subject matter experts and product owners, and give clear progress updates.
Raise risks, issues and dependencies early, and deliver within the agreed scope.
Write clear technical documentation and hand work over cleanly.
 Requirements: 
Solid hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (preferred) or AWS , including cloud networking : VNets / VPCs, routing, VPN / ExpressRoute, NSGs / firewalls and DNS.
Strong networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, routing, DNS, HTTP/S and network security principles.
Experience with Infrastructure as Code ( Terraform ) and/or configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps, GitHub or GitLab.
Scripting or programming skills in at least one language (Python, PowerShell, Go or Java).
 Windows and/or Linux administration experience.
A good understanding of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts.
Excellent English, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
Self-driven and reliable, comfortable working remotely with a UK-based team.
 Nice to have / Preferred Qualifications: 
Hands-on SD-WAN / SASE experience. Cato Networks is ideal; Zscaler, Prisma SASE, Fortinet or Meraki are also relevant.
Experience with Rubrik, or with Veeam / Commvault and a willingness to learn Rubrik.
Azure or AWS certifications.
ITIL Foundation certification.
Knowledge of cloud-native architecture patterns.
Experience in large, complex enterprise organisations, ideally in energy, utilities or other critical infrastructure.
 What we offer: 
Fully remote work.
A flexible benefits budget you can use for a range of expenses.
Premium private medical insurance.
Extra days of annual leave.
Access to certification programmes, with certification costs covered by the company.
A free Udemy subscription.
Access to industry conferences.
 About Computacenter 
 Computacenter is a leading independent technology and services provider, trusted by large corporate and public sector organisations. We are a responsible business that believes in sustainable long-term value creation.
 We help our customers to source, transform and manage their technology infrastructure to deliver digital transformation, enabling people and their businesses.
 Computacenter plc is a public company quoted on the London Stock Exchange (CCC.L) and a member of the FTSE 100. Computacenter employs over 21,000 people worldwide.
